At Ancorotti Cosmetics, beauty makes up our soul. We are a contract manufacturing company that
believes in the worldwide value of made-in-Italy cosmetics. Thriving on collaboration with clients
from all over the globe, we capture each brand’s identity to craft tailor-made makeup and skincare
products. Think of us as your R&D powerhouse, a reliable partner with the industrial know-how to
bring your dream product to life – all the way sharing valuable insights into emerging trends and
technological innovations. Let’s together spread the culture of smart, green and happy
manufacturing: by choosing us, you embrace a commitment to product safety, workplace wellbeing, and
the sustainable development of people and planet.

## What we do

### R&D

Begin your journey by browsing through our latest developed formulas while we offer a strategic
consultancy on the hottest trends aligned with your target market.

Then, brief us on your needs: together we’ll explore all possible solutions!

Now, sit back, relax and enjoy a product proposal tailored to your specifications in terms of
blacklist, color, finish, claims, active ingredients, decoration technique and packaging design.

1

## What we do

### Bulk

Time to kick off production! To create cosmetic bulk, we use exclusively premium raw materials and
state-of-the-art industrial machines – some of them with absolutely huge capacities.

During this delicate process, our rigorous quality control procedures entail systematic testing to
ensure that the bulk matches your approved standard and complies with all physical and chemical
requirements.

Product safety is our first and utmost concern!

2

## What we do

### Fill

Our industrial lines are equipped with the latest technologies to carry out quick, safe and accurate
filling and assembly operations.

We can handle even the most challenging packaging formats!

If you prefer to select and purchase the packaging for your project by yourself, just ship the
components to our warehouse or let us coordinate directly with your supplier: we’ll do the rest.

3

## What we do

### Full

More than just a supplier, ANCOROTTI COSMETICS is your total solution provider!

Choose our full-service option and get turnkey products ready for sale.

Also thanks to our extensive network of trusted partners, we take care of the entire industrial
journey of each single item including labelling and secondary packaging – while ensuring that you
have complete visibility over the status of your project.

4

**A JOURNEY OF TRANSFORMATION**
**A JOURNEY OF TRANSFORMATION**

“La Fabbrica per l’Uomo” is a book telling the fascinating story of how an Olivetti typewriter
factory, left abandoned for decades, was brought to new life thanks to the booming industry of
made-in-Italy cosmetics. A symbol of the industrial past of our hometown, this manufacturing plant
now stands as a landmark of beauty and innovation. The restoration project embodies our company’s
commitment to a zero-land-consumption philosophy. To celebrate this transformation, we are releasing
a series of interviews featuring former Olivetti managers who once worked there, sharing their
memories and experiences.

factory, left abandoned for decades, was brought to new life thanks to the booming industry of
made-in-Italy cosmetics. A symbol of the industrial past of our hometown, this manufacturing plant
now stands as a landmark of beauty and innovation. The restoration project embodies our company’s
commitment to a zero-land-consumption philosophy. To celebrate this transformation, we are releasing
a series of interviews featuring former Olivetti managers who once worked there, sharing their
memories and experiences.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about cosmetic manufacturing, custom formulations, packaging options,
and MOQ logistics.

### What are your minimum order quantities (MOQs)?

Our standard MOQ is 5,000 units for custom formulations and high-end private label packaging (such
as serums, face wash, or luxury jars). For basic packaging or stock formulas, we can occasionally
facilitate smaller runs of 3,000 units depending on the packaging type.

### Do you charge for formulation engineering and sampling?

We provide basic formulation matching and stock samples for qualified cosmetic businesses for free.
For highly complex custom cosmetic formulation development requiring clinical trials or special
sourcing, a standard R&D fee is charged, which is offset against the final production invoice.

### Are your cosmetic formulas cruelty-free and vegan?

Yes, all our formulas are 100% cruelty-free and we never test on animals. We offer certified vegan,
natural, organic, and Ayurvedic compliant options built with premium plant extracts.

### Do you provide regulatory support and MSDS certificates?

Absolutely. We provide comprehensive compliance support, including Certificate of Analysis (COA),
Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), stability and microbial testing reports, and support with FDA or
local AYUSH registrations.

### Can you work with custom packaging sourced by our brand?

Yes. While we offer full-service sourcing, you can also ship your own custom containers directly to
our Indore facility for filling, labeling, and sealing.

### What is your standard production lead time?

For repeat orders with stock formulations, our typical lead time is 3-4 weeks. For new custom
formulations, including stability testing and packaging sourcing, the initial timeline is typically
8-12 weeks.

### Do you offer drop-shipping or fulfillment services?

Currently, we focus exclusively on B2B manufacturing and do not offer direct-to-consumer fulfillment
or drop-shipping. We ship bulk pallets directly to your chosen warehouse or distribution center.

### Can you match a benchmark product formulation?

Yes, our R&D chemists specialize in reverse-engineering and matching benchmark products. Simply
provide us with a physical sample and the ingredient list, and we can develop a comparable or
superior formulation.

# Beautyworld Dubai

## Where global beauty decides what's next

## The visitor registration is now live!

Beautyworld Dubai brings the global beauty supply chain together in the world's most connected trade
hub, Dubai. Every part of the beauty supply chain, fragrance, cosmetics, skincare, hair, beauty tech
and packaging, in one place, in one visit.

In just three days, you’ll discover what's next in beauty, build partnerships and drive business
growth.

Instead of months spent travelling, sourcing, comparing suppliers and chasing introductions, you'll
find the products and discover the insights that matter most in one powerful marketplace.

Register by **31 August** to secure your complimentary pass before **the USD 75 visitor fee starts
on 1 September.**

Miss it and you’re chasing it for the rest of the year.

El know-how adquirido a través de la experiencia y la formación continua de nuestro equipo nos
posiciona entre los fabricantes de cosmética referentes en España para marcas internacionales, con
capacidad de abordar proyectos también vinculados a la [peluquería profesional][92].

Como fabricante a terceros de productos cosméticos, tratamos de interiorizar el concepto de marca de
nuestro cliente y crear el cosmético que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades, tanto en el desarrollo
del producto como para ofrecer cosméticos a precio de fábrica, incluyendo líneas inspiradas en la
[cosmética coreana][93].

Trabajaremos juntos para definir primero el proyecto, elaborar las muestras que mejor se adapten a
vuestra solicitud y después realizar los trabajos administrativos regulados por la Unión Europea
para su venta.

## Expert Turnkey Contract Manufacturer
## of Cosmetics and Skin Care since 1988

Classic Cosmetics is a well-known leader in turnkey contract manufacturing of high-quality color
cosmetics and skin care products. We service a wide variety of clients ranging from large global and
domestic brands to “direct to consumer” and influencer labels. Our family owned company has been
developing cutting-edge formulas that have led the way in this industry since 1988. From concept to
launch, we partner with our clients to provide outstanding customer service at every turn. We are
certified to ISO 22716:2007-2008 European standards and have the expertise and capacity to meet your
needs. Classic Cosmetics is an audited and approved Global Supply Chain partner for many of the
world’s largest beauty brands. Whether you are large or small, starting a new brand, or managing an
existing brand, our team of dedicated professionals are ready to exceed your expectations for
service and quality. [Email or Call us][15] to find out how we can be your partner in success.

## Quality

Our job is to make sure that our clients are successful. That means we provide full support from the
time we start development until we ship your order. Our cGMP certification to European ISO 22716
means that every department is trained to serve our clients’ needs from start to finish. Our goal is
to not only deliver formulas that function as expected, but also address trending needs in the
marketplace. We want to help you lead the way, not follow what others have already done.

## Custom & Wholesale Cosmetic Jars Products

Our business encompasses the customization and wholesale distribution of excellent products such as
Acrylic Cosmetic Jars, Glass Cosmetic Jars, Plastic Cosmetic Jars, and Aluminum Cosmetic Jars.

## Our Business & Service

#### Transparency

Clear or transparent jars showcase product colors, textures, and usage levels, enhancing product
presentation and meeting customer needs.

#### Customizability

Cosmetic jars allow for customizable designs, labels, and closures, offering branding opportunities
and catering to specific product needs.

#### Preservation

They provide a secure and sealed storage environment, protecting cosmetic formulations from external
factors, ensuring their efficacy and quality.

  ### [TELL ME MORE][51]

### **Be An International Retailer or Distributor Of Premium US Beauty Products**

We are looking for individuals with strong marketing and sales management skills. Go Getters.

There are a couple of ways to become a partner in this exciting venture:
1. As a **RETAILER**, you carry the products in your store. Our retailers sell between $2,700 and
   $16,000 per month. You’ll need $3,000 US for your startup inventory.

2. As an **EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTOR**, you’ll own the wholesaling business for your country. Our
distributors earn between $180,000 and $350,000 annually. You will need $6,000 for your startup
inventory. 

Whichever path you choose, you will be assigned a senior sales manager who will train you on selling
and marketing your products. And you will be provided with ongoing guidance to ensure your success
and get you up to speed quickly and profitably. 

[ Receive More Information ][52]

* [Close-up of a woman with long, wavy red hair, captioned 'Color Me Beautiful'.]
  
  ## COLOR ME BEAUTIFUL
  
  Based on the #1 New York Times bestseller, this brand has lead the way in customizing color
  cosmetics for and individual's unique coloring. This approach makes choosing perfect products
  easy, it builds long term customer relationships.
* [A woman with clear skin touching her face, advertising Adrien Arpel Skin.]
  
  ## ADRIEN ARPEL SKINCARE AND SPA
  
  Formulated for the maturing woman. Supported by laboratory testing, these products deliver younger
  looking and feeling skin. Featuring fruit, vegetables and botanical extracts that are a delight to
  the senses- the Adrien Arpel line makes every day a day at the spa.
* [Portrait of a woman with dark, wavy hair and makeup, wearing a black top with a semi-sheer
  pattern. Text overlay reads 'Flori Roberts'.]
  
  ## FLORI ROBERTS COSMETICS
  
  Color cosmetics and skin care designed for women of color. Leading the way with the best quality
  products and color selections enhance the exotic beauty of the woman of color. nique and natural
  break-through products which even skin tone and brightens skin within 30 days.
* [Close-up of a woman with dark wavy hair, bold red lipstick, and red nail polish, with her hand
  touching her face]
  
  ## GALE HAYMAN BEVERLY HILLS COSMETICS
  
  Immediate anti-aging skincare as well as products developed by Gale Hayman, co-founder of the
  famous Giorgio of Beverly Hills. Award winning products. A TV retailing and makeup artist's
  favorite.

## Why Checking Your Cosmetic Batch Code Matters

In the pursuit of flawless skin and stunning makeup looks, the freshness of your products plays a
pivotal role. Cosmetics, just like food, have a shelf life. Using expired products can lead to a
host of problems, from diminished efficacy to potential skin irritation, infections, or allergic
reactions. COSR.AI is your trusted partner in deciphering these crucial dates, empowering you to
make informed decisions about your beauty routine.

### The Hidden Dangers of Expired Cosmetics:
* **Reduced Effectiveness:** Active ingredients in skincare can degrade over time, making your
  expensive serums and creams less potent. Expired makeup might not apply as smoothly or last as
  long.
* **Bacterial Growth:** Once opened, cosmetics are exposed to air and bacteria. Preservatives lose
  their power over time, turning your products into breeding grounds for harmful microorganisms.
  This is especially risky for eye products.
* **Skin Irritation & Allergies:** Chemical changes in aging products can create new compounds that
  may irritate your skin, causing redness, itchiness, breakouts, or even allergic contact
  dermatitis.
* **Wasted Money:** Using products past their prime means you're not getting the benefits you paid
  for. Knowing the freshness helps you use items when they are most effective.

## How COSR.AI Helps You Stay Fresh and Safe

Our sophisticated cosmetic batch code checker tool is designed to be your go-to resource for
verifying product authenticity and freshness. Here's how we make it simple:
1. 1 **Select Your Brand:** Choose from our extensive database of thousands of popular and niche
   cosmetic brands. We are constantly updating this list.
2. 2 **Enter the Batch Code:** Find the batch code on your product's packaging. It's usually a short
   string of letters and numbers printed or embossed on the container.
3. 3 **Get Instant Results:** Our system analyzes the code and provides you with the manufacturing
   date, estimated shelf life, and the calculated expiration date.

Beyond just dates, COSR.AI aims to be an educational hub. We provide information on how to find
batch codes for specific brands, understand PAO (Period After Opening) symbols, and general tips for
extending the life of your cosmetics safely.

### Understanding Cosmetic Dating: Key Terms
* **Batch Code (or Lot Number):** A unique identifier assigned by manufacturers to a specific
  production run of a product. This code contains encrypted information about the manufacturing
  date.
* **Manufacturing Date (MFD):** The date when the product was made. This is the primary piece of
  information our tool decodes.
* **Shelf Life:** The period during which an unopened product, stored correctly, will remain stable,
  effective, and safe to use. This is typically 2-5 years for most cosmetics.
* **Expiration Date:** The date after which a product should not be used, even if unopened. For
  products with a shelf life under 30 months, an explicit expiration date is often printed. Our tool
  calculates an estimated expiration date based on the manufacturing date and typical shelf life.
* **Period After Opening (PAO):** Indicated by a symbol of an open jar with a number followed by "M"
  (e.g., "12M"), this tells you how long a product remains safe and effective after it has been
  opened for the first time, regardless of its original expiration date (as long as it's within that
  date).

## What is a Cosmetic Batch Code?

A batch code (sometimes called a lot number or lot code) is a unique identifier printed on your
beauty product's packaging that helps manufacturers track production data. It's a crucial piece of
information that contains encoded manufacturing details, including the production date—which is
essential for determining if your product is still safe to use.

### Where to Find Batch Codes
* Bottom of containers (common for foundation bottles, lipsticks, etc.)
* On the crimped edge of tubes (mascaras, lip glosses)
* Printed on the outer packaging box
* Near the barcode or ingredient list
* Stamped or etched directly onto glass bottles (perfumes)

  dermatitis.

* Bottom of containers (common for foundation bottles, lipsticks, etc.)

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One

## Our Story

At Fame Cosmetics, we’re passionate about being your **trusted ****custom cosmetics manufacturer**.
We specialize in private label solutions and understand that every brand has its own unique story
and needs. That’s why we create **OEM/ODM products** tailored just for you!

Our dedicated team is here to provide exceptional service and support, always looking for innovative
ways to help you succeed and grow your brand in the beauty world. Let’s work together to bring your
vision to life!

[ Contact us ][50]

## Our advantage

Discover why we are the ideal partner for your cosmetic needs.

##### Certified Quality Assurance

Our factory is ISO 22716 and GMPC certified, ensuring international safety and quality standards—so
you can trust what you sell.

##### Customized Solutions

We create custom formulations and packaging that reflect your brand, helping your products stand
out.

##### Premium Ingredients

Our partnerships with top suppliers like BASF and Roche secure high-quality raw materials for
superior products.

##### Innovative Development

Our lab launches over 100 new formulations each year, keeping you ahead of market trends and
customer demands.

##### Expert Training and Management

With extensive team training and strict procedures, we ensure safe, efficient production and
high-quality results.

##### Global Reach

Our products are exported to the USA, Brazil, the EU, and beyond, earning a strong reputation for
quality and exceptional customer service.

[Fame cosmetics lab]

### Comprehensive Quality Control

At fame, we know that quality is the foundation of our business. That’s why we’re committed to
delivering high-quality products that meet our customers’ expectations, and we’re always looking for
ways to improve our quality control process to ensure that every product meets our high standards.

[ check More ][51]

### Exhibition

Each year, we attend top industry exhibitions to showcase our latest products and innovations. It’s
a great opportunity for us to connect with customers, partners, and industry experts, and to stay
up-to-date on the latest trends and developments.

## A World-Class Cosmetics OEM & ODM Manufacturer in Guangzhou

Guangzhou Fmo Beauty Co., Ltd. is a professional OEM & ODM cosmetics manufacturer located in
Guangzhou, China, with nearly 20 years of experience in the beauty industry. We specialize in the
development, production, and customization of high-quality makeup products, providing one-stop
private label solutions for beauty brands worldwide.

Our factory is strategically located in Baiyun District, only 10 minutes from Guangzhou Baiyun
International Airport, and operates under strict international quality standards. Equipped with
advanced production lines, professional laboratories, and modern testing facilities, we are
committed to delivering safe, innovative, and market-driven cosmetic products.

📍
Prime Location in Baiyun District

## From Raw Materials to Market-Ready Cosmetics

Our three-stage integrated manufacturing process — Emulsification, Precision Filling, and
Professional Packaging — ensures consistent quality and efficient turnaround for every order.

[Cosmetics emulsification process in Fmo Beauty factory — blending and mixing ingredients]
01

### Emulsification

Our pharmaceutical-grade emulsification vessels precisely blend active ingredients, pigments, and
base formulas at controlled temperatures. Every batch is tested for viscosity, pH, and stability
before advancing to the next stage — guaranteeing formula consistency across each production run.

[Precision filling line at Fmo Beauty cosmetics factory — filling lip gloss and foundation bottles]
02

### Filling

Our semi-automatic and fully automatic filling lines handle a wide range of product viscosities —
from lightweight lip oils to thick cream foundations. Precision volumetric dosing systems minimize
waste and ensure each unit is filled to exact specifications, with inline weight-check controls.

[Cosmetics packaging line at Fmo Beauty — assembling and quality checking finished beauty products]
03

### Packaging

From heat shrink wrapping and carton assembly to final QC inspection and barcode verification, our
packaging department handles the complete finishing process. We support custom packaging designs,
private label printing, and retail-ready configurations for global markets.

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing

additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed

## katie stapleton | AIA, leed ap

Katie Stapleton has 20 years of professional experience in programming, designing and managing the
build out of high-end corporate interiors, institutional and residential projects. During her time
on the end-user side for two Fortune 500 companies, she has partnered with outside design firms to
develop and implement various workplace strategies, focusing on strategic occupancy planning, agile
[or activity based] working, and change management.

She has worked on all phases of a project, as both the architect and the owner, including lease
review, program development, test-fit layouts, budget and schedule development, contract documents,
furniture selection and procurement, construction management, move management, and post-occupancy
services. She is also knowledgeable in building information modeling and sustainable design
practices, and has integrated them on a multitude of projects.

She has also been involved with the Architectural League as a freelance writer and research
associate for their Urban Omnibus site, exploring areas of architectural interest in New York City.

Katie holds a Bachelor of Architecture from Penn State University and has been a licensed Architect
in the State of New York since 2011.

Luxury Beauty Wholesale gives approved businesses access to premium beauty wholesale across
skincare, cosmetics, fragrance, haircare, bath and body, and fast-moving beauty stock. Built for
retailers, e-commerce sellers, pharmacies, salons, and distributors, our membership-based platform
connects buyers to a curated global supply network with speed, confidence, and control. For
businesses looking for a reliable beauty wholesaler in the UK, LBW offers more than product access.

a premium, fast-moving beauty supply chain.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

your supply chain.

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.

co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.
